model: HistGradientBoostingRegressor, separate UTS and 0.2% proof-stress models
research_status: exploratory research baseline only; not approved for product/service prediction
features: test temperature, source-record wt.% composition, casting route/gradient, and every recorded solution/precipitation heat-treatment stage

yield_strength.reason: 24 observations is insufficient for a defensible independent benchmark

boundaries: The training lane covers cast, DS, single-crystal and two additive records; it is not a wrought-alloy model.
A test Tag is excluded entirely from fit, but limited test-tag counts mean metrics remain exploratory.
Predictions do not establish creep life, oxidation resistance, phase stability, melting range, manufacturability or certification.
